text: On the surface, this app "works" well. Unfortunately, the developer is intent on nickel-and-diming everyone. There's a super low weekly word limit because they want you to pay for their $30 monthly premium subscription. There are also constant pop-ups almost every time that you hit the dictate button advertising premium. It's so in your face that it makes this app thoroughly unpleasant to use. When I first started, I would rarely run out of words. now it takes like 2 days.
